subject: Scheduling: Lumen agreement review & supplier onboarding window
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Terry Cole <terry.cole@lumenhealth.com>, Megan Holt <megan.holt@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Scheduling: Lumen agreement review & supplier onboarding window

Hi Terry / Megan—

Thanks again for the intro last week. We pulled together an updated MSA with our suggested redlines (attached) and want to set a focused session to walk through the changes with your legal and procurement leads. Goal: identify non-starters vs items we can resolve quickly so we can lock a target go-live window.

Suggested format: 45 minutes — first 30 legal redline review, last 15 onboarding/practical ops items (billing, data handling, support SLA). If useful we can follow with a short tech/ops deep-dive next week.

Availability from our side: Tue 21 Jul 10:00–12:00 PT or Wed 22 Jul 13:00–16:00 PT. If those don't work, send two windows that suit your team.

Attachments: Lumen_MSA_Redline_v2.pdf (redlines inline), agenda-20260721.docx (proposed outline)

Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can lock a room and invite the right SMEs.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference — Developer-first LLM inference platform

From: Megan Holt <megan.holt@lumenhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Terry Cole <terry.cole@lumenhealth.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 17:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Lumen agreement review & supplier onboarding window

Marcus—

Thanks for sending. Terry is our procurement lead and I looped him in. We reviewed the attached briefly and there are a handful of commercial items we expect to table, plus a couple of data residency questions for security.

We can do Tue 21 Jul 10:30–11:15 PT (tight) or Wed 22 Jul 14:00–15:00 PT (preferred). Can you confirm who will be on the call from your legal and security sides? Also please include a row-by-row doc if you have one — it helps speed up redline decisions.

Megan Holt
Sr. Manager, Vendor Management | Lumen Health
megan.holt@lumenhealth.com | 617-555-8890

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Megan Holt <megan.holt@lumenhealth.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Terry Cole <terry.cole@lumenhealth.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 08:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Lumen agreement review & supplier onboarding window

Hi Megan / Marcus—

We can cover both legal and ops in the 45-minute slot if Wed 22 Jul 14:00–15:00 PT works — Marcus and I will be on for legal redlines; Evelyn (ops) will join for the last 15 minutes to cover onboarding checklist (billing flow, support SLAs, data retention).

Quick notes for the meeting so we move fast:
- We'll prepare a short row-by-row summary (pulling from the attached PDF) and flag the ~5 escalation items we expect to need negotiation.
- Please send any internal Lumen-specific requirements (KMS/HSM needs, audit frequency, or PO terms) ahead of the call.
- If there are separate technical SMEs for compliance, loop them in — we may want a quick follow-up tech deep-dive.

Attaching: redwood-security-pack.pdf (security posture summary) — high level only; happy to share SOC2 artifacts under NDA.

If Wed 22 is confirmed we'll send a calendar invite with Zoom and the row-by-row doc by EOD.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.ai

From: Terry Cole <terry.cole@lumenhealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Megan Holt <megan.holt@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Lumen agreement review & supplier onboarding window

Priya / Marcus—

Wed 22 Jul 14:00–15:00 PT works for procurement/legal. We'll have our legal counsel (Debra Shaw) dial in for the redlines and I will bring the PO/billing requirements.

Please share the row-by-row and the Zoom link. Also, can you confirm whether Redwood requires a minimum contract term (we didn't see that flagged in the redlines file).

Thanks — Terry
Terry Cole | Senior Procurement Lead, Lumen Health
procurement@lumenhealth.com | 206-555-3344

Perfect — Wed 22 Jul 14:00–15:00 PT is confirmed. Calendar invite sent from my calendar (Zoom link below).

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210
Agenda (45m):
- 0–30m: MSA redline walk (Marcus / Priya)
- 30–45m: Onboarding, billing & support checklist (Evelyn)
- Next steps: target a short follow-up tech deep-dive and procurement PO checklist.

Pre-reads attached: Lumen_MSA_Redline_v2.pdf; row-by-row will be uploaded to the invite (DocuSign link if we progress to signature).

One ask: please confirm the list of attendees from Lumen so we can include the right SMEs.

Thanks all — looking forward to it.

Marcus
